commitments.target: Achieve a top line of INR 500 crore to INR 600 crore in pharma segment in a couple of years
commitments.quote: As we have stated earlier, achieving a INR 500 crore – INR 600 crore top line is when you would see these things move into a positive phase. This could be a couple of years, if not a bit more than that to get to that phase.
commitments.speaker: Mayank Singhal

commitments.target: Target about $80 million to $100 million of revenue in electronic chemicals space in 5-6 years
commitments.quote: Five-six years is the estimate about somewhere about $ 80 million to $ 100 million of revenue in this space.
commitments.speaker: Mayank Singhal

commitments.target: Maintain resilient EBITDA margin of 25% for full year
commitments.quote: Further, at EBITDA level, we delivered what we committed at the start of the year a resilient margin of 25% for full year.
commitments.speaker: Sanjay Agarwal

claims.claim: Our Pharma business delivered 40% growth for the full year.
claims.quote: Our Pharma business delivered 40% growth for the full year.

claims.claim: Biologicals has been compounding at over 20%+, emerging as one of the fastest-growing segments.
claims.quote: Over the past few years this business has emerged as one of the fastest-growing segments within our portfolio compounding at over 20%+.

claims.claim: Gross margin expanded to 58% during the quarter and year supported by mix and operational efficiencies.
claims.quote: Our gross margin expanded to 58% during the quarter & for the year, supported by a favourable product mix and strong operational efficiencies.

claims.claim: New products now contribute 18% of AgChem Exports, highlighting derisking and innovation approach.
claims.quote: New products now contributing 18% of AgChem Exports highlights our focused derisking strategy and innovation led approach.

claims.claim: On a full year basis, the ETR for FY26 remains at 22%.
claims.quote: on a full year basis, the ETR for FY26 remains at 22%.

analyst_concerns.question: Where is capex directed and when will INR 2,600 crore convert to revenue given drop in asset turns?
analyst_concerns.quote: So, wanted to understand where this capex is being directed to and, some sense in terms of how much of it is being focused towards the legacy projects and the new projects. And when do you expect this capex to be translating into the revenues?

analyst_concerns.question: EBITDA margin compressed from 27%-28% to 22% in recent quarters; how to think about margins for fiscal 27?
analyst_concerns.quote: whereas we started the year with a 27%-28% margin profile. Just going into fiscal ‘27, if you could just give us some sense of, you know, how should we think about margin profiles both on the gross margin level and the EBITDA margin level?

analyst_concerns.question: Why has agrochemicals remained dominant despite a decade of discussing adjacencies like pharma and electronic chemicals?
analyst_concerns.quote: as on today, from management’s perspective, was the original assumption that PI’s process chemistry and customer trust advantages would automatically transfer more easily across domains than they actually did? And what has been the biggest, unexpected challenge in building meaningful non-agro scale?

analyst_concerns.question: What would CSM export growth be excluding the largest product, pyroxasulfone, for FY26?
analyst_concerns.quote: So, just apart from the new molecules, even the existing molecules which you would have launched prior to that, right? So, if we just strip out the impact of the largest product, pyroxasulfone, excluding that, would there have been growth in FY26 in CSM exports or that would have been a YoY decline?
